entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese home-center broom context and all twelve full sets. Verified outdoor balcony drain sand, separate dustpan, eighty-centimeter storage height, display telescopic lock test, combined thickness versus cupboard depth and final two-item choice.

Verified fifty-centimeter width insufficient with manual heat clearance, window-side alternative may hit desk, open-door dimensions and cord reach checked, no purchase until remeasured. Clarified Traditional Chinese remeasurement verb.

Read Japanese cooking-class context and all twelve full sets. Verified yesterday index-finger cut, no forced knife or food handling, partner cuts and handles hot pots, reading quantities and sequence after watching demo, cleanup tasks keeping injured hand dry. Corrected Tagalog instructor/pair role and Thai ingredient noun.

Read Japanese postal move-notification context and all twelve full sets. Verified only player moves, roommate stays, full old address, new room number forgotten not guessed, unfinished form taken home with guide and only own name before return.

Read Japanese food-factory packaging context and all twelve full sets. Verified torn right glove touched last three bags, separate inspection tray rather than shipping, supervisor decides product handling, change away from product and no return of isolated bags after handwashing. Clarified glove rather than finger holes in eleven locales.

Read Japanese temple collection context and all twelve full sets. Verified lost claim tag, two blue covers insufficient, pencil surname inside back cover, discreet Nguyen confirmation without other visitors pages, wait without touching until ink dries. Clarified Burmese received inscription and Chinese spoken address.

Read Japanese takeaway-sushi order context and all twelve full sets. Verified Lin original five-thirty delayed by work, six-thirty confirmed, two nigiri portions unchanged, call as soon as further delay known and direct return to accommodation. Naturalized Chinese address.

Read Japanese zoo entrance/exit context and all twelve full sets. Verified unspecified exit and unanswered ringing phone, adult male green jacket white hat, player stays by entrance information board and messages, reply locates other exit then friend comes over. Corrected Bengali staff inquiry action.

Verified lifting goods requires free arms, cuffs first too long, second fit and back movement checked, wash label versus workplace laundry net, trial/purchase sizes matched and navy one jacket. Clarified Burmese indoors versus underwear.

Verified mud-packed boots no slope, lower plot pending supervisor inspection, empty harvest boxes under roof, old variety label kept pending check, two wet-bottom boxes apart from dry and wait for call. Full Japanese context and twelve locales read: pond sketching with folding chair and board at plaza edge, shadows permit movement only in designated area, board legs outside path, pencil only with eraser waste bag, bridge main lines before shadow shifts.

Full source and twelve locales checked: destination changed after entry, boarding station on original ticket, machine shows hundred-yen difference paid in coins, replacement received and original retained, right exit and message to friend retained.

Full source and twelve locales checked: tomorrow ten-AM housing consultation requested phone change, documents ready in quiet room with sending-method question; Friday afternoon only fallback if face-to-face needed, change unconfirmed and original not self-cancelled.

Read Japanese context and twelve locales: hearing aid retained, mask word-boundary difficulty and slow speech requested, medicines and appointments written, attending alone and asking immediately rather than assuming hearing; nearby name call and entrance retained. Khmer spoken alternatives resolved.

Read Japanese context and twelve locales: unknown company demands unused service payment by purchased electronic-money number; not bought, eleven today and company name noted, same number called twice after hangup, unanswered, consultation continues with screen and notes.

Read full source context and twelve locales: six photos already water-protected, two cardboard sheets outside bag, larger fitting envelope with directly written address, count before sealing and weight/thickness for postage; no added guarantee about transport protection.

Read full source context and twelve locales: next-month time deposit maturity, part for house repair with estimate pending, contract-specific renewal/withdrawal explanation before decision, cannot attend maturity-date question, certificate and ID present. Khmer spoken affirmative cleaned.

Full source and twelve locales read: six water bottles divided three per sturdy paid bag, both bags checked inside and secured in bicycle basket, box opened at designated table then empty box collected before home. Khmer slash alternatives replaced with spoken affirmative.

Full source and twelve locales read: purple salvia label opposite flowerbed, narrow-leaved neighbor separate kind, photos include leaves and labels taken from walkway and compared at home; no invented name for second plant.
